raw.title: (Senior) Robotic Sales Engineer
raw.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your mission

As a Robotic Sales Engineer (RSE), you are RobCo’s technical face to the customer and the technical lead on every deal you own, from the first customer call to a handover-ready solution. You work as a team with our Account Executives, and every technical question on the deal runs through you. You carry a quota together with your AE, and you win deals as a team.

Your job is to understand the customer’s process better than anyone else in the room, decide early what is feasible and what is not, and turn a real production problem into a clear, qualified automation case. You recommend the right automation approach and hand it over to our Solutions Development team without late surprises.

You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. You show customers what robots that perceive, learn and adapt can do in their plant today. You have direct access to the engineers, product managers and data behind our robots, and you help shape what we build next.

What you will do

  • Qualify – Join discovery calls and site visits with your AE. Assess use cases early for technical fit, business value and risk, and say no when a deal does not fit.

  • Run requirement workshops – Lead structured on-site workshops with production, engineering and operations teams. Capture parts, processes, cycle times, layout, interfaces, safety and acceptance criteria.

  • Check feasibility – Make the first technical call on reach, payload, cycle time, gripping and vision. Use quick layouts, simulations and tests to back it up, and pull in Product or Solutions Development where needed.

  • Drive the concept – Turn workshop results into clear requirements and recommend the right automation approach. You own the collaboration with Solutions Development and Product until a complete, buildable concept is in place.

  • Be the technical face to the customer – Explain our robots and solutions to plant managers, engineers and executives in plain language. Run demos and support business cases and RaaS pricing inputs.

  • Close the loop – Feed field insights back to Product, so what customers need shapes what we build.

What you bring

  • 3+ years where automation meets the customer: technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects

  • You want to be measured by results: you share a quota with your AE and push deals over the line

  • You have had your hands on robot cells, from grippers and vision to feeders, conveyors and safety, and you know what makes them run on the shop floor

  • You walk through a plant, watch a process for ten minutes and see where automation pays off

  • You lead conversations with confidence, whether with an operator on the line or the plant manager signing off the investment

  • You think in structure: after your workshop, the team can build on what you captured

  • You can sketch a layout or check reach in CAD or simulation (e.g. Autodesk Fusion, Visual Components)

  • You speak German and English fluently and enjoy being on the road, around 30% of the time

  • Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus

  • Know-how in machine tending, palletizing, assembly or pick-and-place is a plus

  • Robot programming or system integrator experience is a plus

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

B. nach § 26a WEG) besitzt. Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der WEG-Verwaltung vorweisen kannst und das Tagesgeschäft sicher beherrschst. Bereits zahlreiche Eigentümerversammlungen selbstständig und souverän geleitet hast. Klar kommunizierst, verhandlungsstark bist und empathisch mit unterschiedlichen Eigentümerinteressen umgehen kannst. description: Sales | Channel Management | Security | Software | German & English Genetec  - Protect the everyday Wir sind ein weltweit tätiges kanadisches Unternehmen mit einem breit gefächerten Lösungsportfolio in den Bereichen Sicherheit, Intelligence und Operations. Unser globales Netzwerk von mehr als 2.300 Mitarbeitenden setzt sich aus vielfältigen Persönlichkeiten zusammen, die ihre Arbeit mit Leidenschaft ausüben und offen für neue Ideen sind. Ihre Aufgaben Als Channel Account Executive (CAE) DACH sind Sie verantwortlich für den Ausbau, die Betreuung und das Wachstum des Genetec-Geschäfts mit bestehenden und neuen Vertriebspartnern in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Channel Sales Engineers, Account Executives, Marketing sowie weiteren internen Teams stärken Sie die Fähigkeiten unserer Partner, schaffen nachhaltiges Pipeline- und Umsatzwachstum und stellen eine konsistente Partnererfahrung sicher. Die Position berichtet direkt an den Area Sales Director DACH. Ausbau des Channel-Geschäfts in der DACH-Region durch die Entwicklung gemeinsamer Geschäftspläne, Umsatzziele und gezielter Wachstumsinitiativen mit ausgewählten Partnern. Betreuung, Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender strategischer Channel- und Lösungspartner sowie Identifikation und Gewinnung neuer Vertriebspartner in der DACH-Region mit besonderem Fokus auf Deutschland. Aufbau und Pflege einer belastbaren, partnergenerierten Vertriebspipeline; Erstellung von Umsatzprognosen sowie regelmäßiges Reporting zu Strategie, Fortschritten, Risiken und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen an das Management. Weiterleitung und Nachverfolgung von Leads gemeinsam mit Partnern, Sicherstellung der Erfassung und Pflege von Opportunities im CRM-System sowie Überwachung von Projekten, die nicht als High-Touch-Deals durch die Account-Executive-Organisation geführt werden. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Account Executives und Channel Sales Engineers bei der Betreuung von Kundenkonten, der Entwicklung von Vertriebsstrategien, der Auswahl geeigneter Partner und der erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten. Koordination der Kommunikation zwischen Vertriebspartnern, Genetec-Abteilungen, Beratern und Technologiepartnern, um einen konsistenten und skalierbaren Go-to-Market-Ansatz sicherzustellen. Planung und Durchführung von Partner-Reviews, Vertriebsenablement-Maßnahmen, Veranstaltungen und gezielten Marketinginitiativen; Koordination technischer Schulungen sowie Überwachung von Trainingserfolg und Partnerzufriedenheit. Ihr Profil Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, auch wenn nicht jede einzelne Anforderung vollständig erfüllt wird. Wenn Sie von dieser Rolle begeistert sind und überzeugt sind, einen Mehrwert leisten zu können, möchten wir Sie gerne kennenlernen. Mindestens 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb und/oder Business Development im Bereich physische Sicherheit, Technologievertrieb oder Lösungsvertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in einer relevanten Channel- oder Business-Development-Funktion. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau neuer Channel-Partnerschaften sowie in der Geschäftsentwicklung mit Systemintegratoren und anderen Lösungspartnern. Fundiertes Verständnis des Marktes für physische Sicherheit, einschließlich Videomanagement-Software, Zutrittskontrollsystemen und der dazugehörigen IT-Infrastruktur. Kenntnisse von VSaaS- (Video Surveillance as a Service) und Cloud-Strategien sowie von direkten Hersteller-zu-Partner-Vertriebsmodellen. Erfahrung in der gemeinsamen Geschäftsplanung mit Partnern, im Opportunity-Management, Forecasting sowie im professionellen Umgang mit CRM-Systemen. Fähigkeit, den Mehrwert der Genetec-Lösungen überzeugend zu vermitteln und Produkt-, Markt- sowie Wettbewerbswissen in konkreten Geschäftsnutzen für Partner zu übersetzen. Ausgeprägte Präsentations-, Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse; zusätzliche Kenntnisse der DACH-Märkte sind von Vorteil. Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der DACH-Region von mindestens 50 % der Arbeitszeit. Proaktive und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit unternehmerischem Denken, Ergebnisorientierung und Freude an Herausforderungen. Positive Ausstrahlung und hohe Energie, die zur Förderung von Teamarbeit, Engagement und einer starken Teamkultur beiträgt. Freude an der Arbeit in einem vielfältigen und internationalen Team. Das bieten wir Ihnen Die Möglichkeit, in einem internationalen und kooperativen Umfeld einen echten Beitrag zu leisten. Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Kreativität, frische Ideen und das Hinterfragen des Status quo fördert. Die Chance, Teil eines weltweit führenden Unternehmens mit einer offenen und unterstützenden Arbeitsatmosphäre zu werden. Zugang zu zahlreichen Vergünstigungen über unser Corporate-Discount-Programm. Kostenlose Französischkurse zur Förderung der internationalen Zusammenarbeit. Teilnahme an internationalen Teamevents und Konferenzen sowie Aufbau wertvoller länderübergreifender Netzwerke. Attraktives Provisionsmodell zur Anerkennung Ihres Beitrags zum Unternehmenserfolg. Kfz-Zuschuss zur Unterstützung Ihrer Reisetätigkeit innerhalb der Region. 30 Urlaubstage für eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance. Zuschuss zu Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten zur Förderung Ihres Wohlbefindens. Genetec ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir diskriminieren niemanden aufgrund von ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Hautfarbe, Religion, Alter, Nationalität, Familienstand, Behinderung, Veteranenstatus, genetischer Informationen, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität oder eines anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmals. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- We are a global Canadian company with a broad solutions portfolio that encompasses security, intelligence, and operations. We serve customers within a wide range of industries including transportation, education, and government. At Genetec we embrace open communication, creativity, and continuous learning to allow everyone to flourish in their own unique career paths. Our network of over 2300 people globally is made up of diverse individuals who are passionate about their work and open to trying new ideas. We prioritize the success and well-being of our employees. Discover Genetec's work environment and lively culture in this video -  here . What your day will look like As Channel Account Executive (CAE) DACH, you will be responsible for developing, managing and growing Genetec business with existing and new channel partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Working closely with Channel Sales Engineers, Account Executives, Marketing and other internal teams, you will strengthen partner capability, create sustainable pipeline and revenue growth, and ensure a consistent partner experience. The role reports directly to the Area Sales Director DACH. Grow channel sales across the DACH territory by developing joint business plans, revenue objectives and targeted growth initiatives with selected partners. Manage, support and further develop existing strategic Channel and solution partners, while identifying and onboarding new channel relationships across the DACH region. Strong Focus on Germany Build and maintain a reliable partner-generated pipeline; develop channel revenue forecasts and regularly report strategy, progress, risks and competitive developments to management. Distribute and follow up leads with partners, ensure opportunities are captured and updated in CRM, and track projects that are not managed as High-Touch deals by the Account Executive organisation. Work closely with Account Executives and Channel Sales Engineers on account coverage, opportunity strategy, partner selection and the successful delivery of customer projects. Coordinate communication between channel partners, Genetec departments, consultants and technology partners to create a consistent and scalable go-to-market approach. Plan and deliver partner business reviews, sales enablement, events and targeted marketing initiatives; coordinate technical training and monitor training effectiveness and partner satisfaction.   About you We welcome all qualified candidates, including those who may not meet every listed requirement. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. At least 7 years of experience in sales and/or business development within physical security, technology or solution sales, including at least 3 years in a relevant channel or business development role. Proven ability to develop new channel relationships and grow business with system integrators and other solution partners. Strong understanding of the physical security market, including video management software, access control systems and related IT infrastructure. Understanding of VSaaS and cloud solution strategies as well as direct manufacturer-to-partner channel models. Experience with partner business planning, opportunity management, revenue forecasting and CRM discipline. Ability to understand and articulate the Genetec value proposition and to translate product, market and competitive knowledge into partner-facing business value. Excellent presentation, communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, combined with a structured, self-driven and collaborative working style. Native-level German and business-fluent English; additional DACH market knowledge is a strong advantage. Willingness to travel within the DACH region for a minimum of 50% of working time. You proactively manage your responsibilities, embrace challenges, and drive meaningful outcomes through an entrepreneurial and results-oriented approach. A positive attitude and high energy, helping to drive teamwork, engagement, and a strong team culture. Exited to work in a diverse Team   What’s in it for you Make a meaningful impact in an international and collaborative environment. Be part of a culture that values creativity, fresh ideas, and challenging the status quo. Join an industry-leading global company with a supportive and open atmosphere. Access a wide range of partner perks through our Corporate Discount Program. Enhance your international collaboration with French language classes. Participate in international team events and conferences, building strong cross-regional connections. Benefit from an Employee Commission Plan that recognizes your contribution to business success. Receive a car allowance to support travel across the region. Enjoy 30 days of vacation to maintain a healthy work-life balance. Take advantage of our Fitness Club contribution to support your well-being.   Genetec is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. What your day will look like

As Channel Account Executive (CAE) DACH, you will be responsible for developing, managing and growing Genetec business with existing and new channel partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Working closely with Channel Sales Engineers, Account Executives, Marketing and other internal teams, you will strengthen partner capability, create sustainable pipeline and revenue growth, and ensure a consistent partner experience. The role reports directly to the Area Sales Director DACH.

  • Grow channel sales across the DACH territory by developing joint business plans, revenue objectives and targeted growth initiatives with selected partners.
  • Manage, support and further develop existing strategic Channel and solution partners, while identifying and onboarding new channel relationships across the DACH region. Strong Focus on Germany
  • Build and maintain a reliable partner-generated pipeline; develop channel revenue forecasts and regularly report strategy, progress, risks and competitive developments to management.
  • Distribute and follow up leads with partners, ensure opportunities are captured and updated in CRM, and track projects that are not managed as High-Touch deals by the Account Executive organisation.

  • Plan and deliver partner business reviews, sales enablement, events and targeted marketing initiatives; coordinate technical training and monitor training effectiveness and partner satisfaction.

 

About you

We welcome all qualified candidates, including those who may not meet every listed requirement. If you're excited about this role and believe you can make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

  • At least 7 years of experience in sales and/or business development within physical security, technology or solution sales, including at least 3 years in a relevant channel or business development role.
  • Proven ability to develop new channel relationships and grow business with system integrators and other solution partners.
  • Strong understanding of the physical security market, including video management software, access control systems and related IT infrastructure.
  • Understanding of VSaaS and cloud solution strategies as well as direct manufacturer-to-partner channel models.
  • Experience with partner business planning, opportunity management, revenue forecasting and CRM discipline.
  • Ability to understand and articulate the Genetec value proposition and to translate product, market and competitive knowledge into partner-facing business value.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, combined with a structured, self-driven and collaborative working style.
  • Native-level German and business-fluent English; additional DACH market knowledge is a strong advantage.
  • Willingness to travel within the DACH region for a minimum of 50% of working time.
  • You proactively manage your responsibilities, embrace challenges, and drive meaningful outcomes through an entrepreneurial and results-oriented approach.
  • A positive attitude and high energy, helping to drive teamwork, engagement, and a strong team culture.
  • Exited to work in a diverse Team

 

What’s in it for you

  • Make a meaningful impact in an international and collaborative environment.
  • Be part of a culture that values creativity, fresh ideas, and challenging the status quo.
  • Join an industry-leading global company with a supportive and open atmosphere.

raw.title: Staff Frontend Engineer / Frontend Architect (m/f/d)
raw.description:
Introduction

Teaser

Two products, two backends, one frontend vision: build the AI-first frontend platform and design system that lets our engineers, product managers and designers ship UI at speed. A senior hands-on role with architect-level influence, no people management, and our CPTO as your executive sponsor.

Role at a glance

  • Level: Staff/Principal-level individual contributor – technical leadership, no direct reports
  • Reporting line: VP Engineering. Executive sponsor: our CPTO
  • Products: FactFinder NG (React on a Java backend) and Infinity (React on a .NET/F# backend)
  • Stack you'll shape: React, TypeScript, Web Components, design tokens, Storybook, AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • Team: Product & Technology organization of around 25 people, led by our CPTO, working in a product trio model with product and design
  • Location: Berlin; Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm possible – hybrid with 2–3 office days per week; occasional travel (<10%) for offsites and design-system workshops
  • Start: as soon as possible

About FactFinder

FactFinder is one of the leading product discovery platforms for European eCommerce. For more than 20 years we've applied AI and machine learning to product search, navigation, personalization and recommendations. Our Product Discovery Experience (PDX) spans two products: FactFinder NG, an exact and highly configurable search, and Infinity, a self-learning, behavioral discovery engine. More than 2,000 customers generate over €160 billion in annual GMV on our platform.

We're around 90 people with a new management team, a clear growth plan and reknown investors behind us. Right now we're rebuilding our product and tech organization around an AI-first way of working and agentic commerce – and this role sits at the center of it.

Why this role exists

Our two products run two React frontends with very different technical roots. We need a vision, an architect, and an owner — someone who will unify them into a single, efficient system, build the shared design system on top, and enable product managers and designers to prototype and ship production-grade UI themselves with AI tooling. Incrementally, without a big-bang rewrite, and while both products keep shipping.


Your mission

What you'll do

  • Define and drive the target frontend architecture across both React products – one consistent, efficient React-based system, migrated step by step
  • Build and own our shared design system: tokens, component library and Web Components for embeddable shop UI, tightly aligned with Product Design
  • Create an AI-first prototyping and contribution framework – design system, AI coding tools, guardrails, automated review and CI – so product managers and designers can prototype and contribute production-grade UI
  • Stay hands-on: write a significant share of the critical code, set standards, and pair with and level up our frontend engineers
  • Work with a clear operating split: after architecture-focused first stints, spend around 80% of your time hands-on coding and 20% on architecture, design-system leadership and enablement
What success looks like
  • After 90 days: frontend audit of both products done, target architecture and migration roadmap agreed, design-system tokens and core components live, and the first prototype built and shipped by a product manager or designer on the new framework
  • After 12 months: both products run on the shared design system, the frontend rework shows measurable efficiency gains, and product and design prototype independently as a routine – frontend is no longer the bottleneck


Your profile

Must-have

  • Expert-level React and TypeScript, proven in complex production SaaS frontends
  • A real AI-first engineering practice: you use AI coding tools and agents daily and have built workflows or frameworks that others use – not just "I use Copilot"
  • Design-system architecture: you've built or led a design system (tokens, component library, Storybook or similar) that was adopted across multiple teams or products
  • Web Components (Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, embedding in third-party environments) plus a frontend architecture track record: you've modernized or migrated a frontend stack at least once, ideally several times
  • 6+ years in frontend or software engineering, including 3+ years at Staff, Lead or Architect level – setting technical direction across teams, not just within your own
  • Hands-on today: you write production code yourself – this is not a concept-only architect position
  • Business-fluent English (C1); no formal degree required, your track record counts
Nice-to-have
  • Technical leadership without line management: you've led a SaaS frontend team through a major technology change
  • Meta-frameworks such as Next.js and/or Astro – and a clear view on when to use which
  • Design-to-code and prototyping tooling: Figma workflows, design-token pipelines, AI UI generation (v0, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • eCommerce, search or product discovery frontends (search UIs, embeddable shop widgets)
  • React on non-JavaScript backends (Java/Spring, .NET); Fable/Feliz or Ant Design
  • Good German language skills


Bonus Points

Who thrives here

  • Builders who ship code themselves and lead by example
  • Pragmatic simplifiers: incremental migration over big-bang rewrites, no over-engineering
  • Change agents with strong opinions, weakly held – able to transform an organization without burning it out
  • Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers
Probably not for you if you'd rather produce architecture concepts than running code, want to go deep on one product and leave the cross-product system to others, or are looking for a people-management role.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

What we offer

  • Real ownership with executive backing: you shape the frontend of two products end to end. You report to our VP Engineering; our CPTO is the executive sponsor of this role – both agree the target architecture and migration roadmap with you, and the CPTO reviews your 90-day goals and holds your final interview. A company-level priority, not a side project
  • AI-first as a leadership priority, with the tooling budget to match: Claude Code, Cursor or whatever makes you fastest
  • Impact without switching to management: a Staff/Principal IC track on our career ladder toward Principal/Distinguished – with the option to move into engineering management later if you want to
  • A product trio culture: engineering, product and design as co-owners, outcomes over outputs
  • Competitive compensation that reflects the Staff level of this role
  • Training and conference budget, 30 days of vacation, modern equipment, mobility offers and a company pension plan
  • Hybrid work with 2–3 office days per week in Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm

How we hire

Remote, with feedback within 48 hours after every step:

1. 30-minute intro call with our Recruiter Mirko
2. 60-minute technical interview with our VP Engineering (your future manager) and an engineering lead: one frontend modernization you led, your design-system story, and how you use AI day to day
3. Case study: a hands-on part (AI tools explicitly welcome – walk us through how you used them) and a 45-minute architecture session
4. Team panel and a 45-minute conversation with our CPTO – optionally on site

FAQ

Is this a people-management role? No. It's a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through architecture, standards and enablement, without direct reports.

Who will I report to? Our VP Engineering. The role is sponsored by our CPTO: the frontend platform is one of the CPTO's top priorities, you agree the target architecture and migration roadmap together, and the CPTO holds your final interview.

Which tech stack will I work with? React and TypeScript on both products. FactFinder NG runs on a Java backend, Infinity on .NET/F# (with Fable/Feliz on the frontend). Backend, F# and our search domain are things you can learn here – React expertise, Web Components, design-system architecture and AI-first practice are what you bring from day one.

Is "AI-first" real here, or a buzzword? It's driven by our CPTO and part of the career ladder for every engineer. Your mandate is to take it from individual productivity to organization-wide practice.

Two legacy frontends on Java and .NET – isn't that painful? That's exactly the mandate: unify them, and how is your call. Incremental, not big-bang.

Can I work fully remote? No – the role is hybrid with 2–3 office days per week at one of our offices.

Why eCommerce search? Because agentic commerce is where AI meets real purchase decisions – on our platform that's 2,000+ shops and €160+ billion in GMV a year.

Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile plus links to work you're proud of (GitHub, a design system, a talk, a blog post) – and tell us in three sentences how you use AI in your daily engineering work. No cover letter needed.

Your contact: Mirko Duus

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
raw.description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt. Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und Coding Agents sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern, Deployment und grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich. Was uns wichtig ist Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst. Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


🌏 Location: You can choose to work in a full-remote mode as long as you're living in either France, Italy, Germany, Serbia, or Spain.

Join us as a Senior Full-Stack Engineer in our Identity Verification team to turn our KYC flow into a service that works with any provider, and to help more customers get from KYC started to KYC submission. 60% of your time goes on the backend, with the web as your second surface.

You will report to Nicola, the Engineering Manager of the Identity Verification team.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Make identity verification provider-agnostic: Replace today’s tightly coupled solution with one service that any team at Qonto can use, whichever provider runs the checks. This is mostly Ruby (90%), with some Go (10%)
  • Improve KYC conversion: Work across backend and web on the path from KYC started to KYC submission, our main objective for the team.
  • Own the web side of provider integrations: Load provider SDKs in the browser, handle the errors they return, and keep the web part running as usage scales. Expect roughly half your time on web at first, moving towards 30% as the work shifts to the backend.

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • Backend experience: You’ve built and run backend services in production, and you’re at ease being backend-first.
  • React on the web: You’ve shipped production web code with React, and you can handle maintenance and scaling work on an existing application.
  • Third-party integrations: You’ve integrated external providers or SDKs, and you know how to design so that a single provider doesn’t lock you in.
  • Range across the stack: You’ll own changes across backend and web, partnering with our staff web engineer on architecture and complex integrations.
  • Ruby, or the will to learn it: Ruby experience is a plus, not a requirement.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Platform work with real users: You build infrastructure behind KYC, the first step every customer takes with Qonto, and you see its effect in the conversion numbers.
  • Build reliable verification flows: Handle provider failures and retries, improve observability, and help the team operate integrations safely in production.
  • A design problem with real trade-offs: We work with several verification providers, each with its own SDK, errors and behaviour. You’ll design the layer that makes them interchangeable, and untangle today’s tightly coupled solution so that changing a provider no longer touches every consumer.
  • A platform other teams build on: KYC is our first internal customer, with other teams potentially following, such as Security for password reset checks. You'll build reliable APIs that other Qonto teams can depend on, while making the verification journey smoother, clearer, and more reliable for our customers.
  • Support from day one: An onboarding buddy from week two, and a weekly one-to-one with your manager.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Nicola, our Engineering Manager.

  • His path? Nicola spent four years at Satispay, progressing from Backend Engineer to Engineering Lead, managing 6–8 engineers. He helped scale their SEPA payment infrastructure from a few thousand to over a million transactions per week before joining Qonto as an Engineering Manager.

He sets clear expectations, encourages autonomy and learning through experimentation, and values direct feedback and open discussions. His goal is to build confident, independent engineers who take ownership of their work.

title: Account Solutions Architect - Greenfield - DACH
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h2> <p>The infrastructure powering the AI era doesn’t sell itself, and the customers building on it don’t want to be sold to. They want a peer. You’ll work as part of a focused three-person team alongside one Account Executive and one Account Manager, together responsible for landing new accounts and expanding within them across the region. The customers you’ll work with are AI labs, research institutions, and enterprises running some of the most demanding GPU workloads in the world. This is a role for someone who shows up with substance, who can hold a real conversation about model training and MLOps tooling in the morning and cluster networking in the afternoon, and who finds the space between infrastructure and application more interesting than either on its own.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role:</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Solution Architect covering Northern EMEA, you’ll move across the full stack depending on what the customer needs, from ML training workflows and MLOps platforms like Weights &amp; Biases to bare metal GPU infrastructure and physical AI deployments. This isn’t a role built around a single layer of the stack, but the majority of your conversations will live in the ML layer. You’ll be expected to go deeper than most when the infrastructure conversation demands it, while staying commercially aware enough to support both new logo pursuits and in-flight account expansion. This role requires up to 40% travel.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cover Northern EMEA, with a focus on the Nordics and Benelux regions (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg).</li> <li>Work closely with one Account Executive and one Account Manager as a dedicated three-person unit, supporting the full land and expand motion across the region.</li> <li>Lead technical discovery with prospects and existing customers to understand model training requirements, MLOps workflows, and infrastructure constraints.</li> <li>Design and present solutions spanning ML infrastructure, GPU compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and MLOps tooling.</li> <li>Run proof-of-concept engagements and architecture reviews, and see them through to a decision.</li> <li>Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding technical requirements and product gaps back to Engineering and Product.</li> <li>Maintain clear documentation of customer architectures, solution designs, and outstanding technical questions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture role, ideally with a focus on AI/ML platforms, cloud infrastructure, or HPC.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of ML training and inference workflows - you understand how models are built, optimized, and deployed, not just where they run.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with MLOps platforms and the tooling AI teams use day-to-day, including experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, and model serving.</li> <li>Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.</li> <li>Comfortable going below the SaaS layer when the conversation demands it - GPU topology, network fabric, and cluster architecture shouldn’t be unfamiliar territory.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads at scale.</li> <li>Strong communication skills - you can adjust your register from a research engineer to a VP of Infrastructure without losing credibility at either end.</li> <li>Experience managing multiple concurrent opportunities across a geographic territory.</li> <li>Fluency in English required; proficiency in Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100, A100, H200) and the software stack around them: CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN.</li> <li>Working knowledge of high-performance networking concepts: InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, TCP/IP.</li> <li>Background working directly with AI labs, research institutions, or enterprise ML teams.</li> <li>Exposure to physical AI use cases and the infrastructure requirements they bring.</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.</li> </ul> <p>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You’re comfortable going one layer deeper than the demo - whether that’s a networking topology, a training job that won’t converge, or a rack layout question from a facilities team.</li> <li>You’ve worked across more than one layer of the stack and find the intersections more interesting than any single discipline.</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-moving environment and take ownership of your region like it’s your own business.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who makes the people around you - including your AE and AM - better at their jobs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h2> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p><em>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms &amp; Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information. &nbsp;To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. &nbsp;CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications&nbsp;</em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><p>Speed is something we fight for every day at Fin, and we believe Berlin is built for people who share that instinct. We are drawn to Berlin by its rare blend of deep technical talent and rich creative culture – all within a vibrant, globally connected city that’s close to our R&amp;D hubs in Dublin and London. It’s a place where the best of the best technical talent thrive, and where people from around the world are eager to relocate and build ambitious products.</p> <p>Our ambition is to hire 100 people in Berlin over the year ahead across engineering, AI, data science, product, and design. We believe this is the most exciting time to join, be the founding R&amp;D talent in the region and make a lasting impact as we build the world's number one customer agent!</p> <h2>What's the opportunity?&nbsp;</h2> <p>Principal Engineers at Fin have the opportunity to lead the definition and execution of key strategic initiatives.<strong> </strong>You will work autonomously and be accountable for strategic execution in part of the engineering organization. You will build both back-end and front-end systems, and work closely with designers, product managers, researchers, and data analysts. You will coach and mentor other engineers and partner closely with the Group Engineering Managers on technical strategy and leadership.</p> <p>Learn more about our engineering culture at <a href="http://intercom.engineering/">intercom.engineering</a></p> <h2>What will I be doing?&nbsp;</h2> <p>As an experienced engineer you will:</p> <ul> <li>Have a mastery of domain knowledge and work as a leader within the R&amp;D org to drive key strategic projects.</li> <li>Provide assessments of project progress, risks and challenges to engineering leadership to help guide resource allocation and prioritisation.</li> <li>Contribute to our technical architecture as we grow. description: Our Opportunity Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate. Your Mission As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver. You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath. You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo. Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties. Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome What you'll own Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver. Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact. Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am. Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access. Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable. Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure. Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job. What success looks like You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use. Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why. You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it. You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you. You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how. What it takes You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement. You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast. You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows. You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy. You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration. You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem. You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers. You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them. Bonus: AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC. LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows. Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning. Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it. Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard. Why Predium? Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit. Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product. Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both. Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.   • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.


What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

Video und Social sind dir nicht fremd. Du erkennst ein Format, das trägt, und bekommst es auch mit kleinen Mitteln umgesetzt. Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Content-Produktion und ein klares Urteil, wo sie trägt und wo nicht. Erfahrung mit erklärungsbedürftigen, emotionalen Entscheidungen. Lead-Gen statt reinem E-Commerce. Erfahrung im Verhandeln von Media-, Sponsoring- oder Produktionsbudgets. Englisch C1 für die Zusammenarbeit im Team. Wenn du bei ein oder zwei Punkten unsicher bist: bewirb dich und schreib uns, wie du dir das aneignen würdest. Wir entscheiden nach deinen Erfahrungen und unserem Gespräch, nicht nach einer Checkliste. Diese Rolle passt nicht, wenn du mit einem Rebranding anfangen willst. Logo und Farben sind nicht unser Engpass. Der Engpass sind Kampagnen und Kanäle. du konzipieren, aber nicht schreiben willst. Am Anfang entstehen die Texte an deinem Schreibtisch. du am liebsten in einer Disziplin bleibst. Dein Feld reicht von der Mailing-Strecke bis zum Gespräch mit einem Sender. du Kreation nach Geschmack beurteilst statt nach Wirkung. du lange Abstimmungsschleifen brauchst. Die Wege sind kurz, dafür entsteht viel in kurzer Zeit. Warum marta? Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile (VSOP nach Jahr 1) und Performance-Bonus 27 Urlaubstage 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche und Vertrauensarbeitszeit Wellhub (Gympass): Zugang zu Fitness, Studios und Wellbeing Ein internationales Team mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig Unser Prozess Fachgespräch, kurze Kampagnenaufgabe, Kennenlernen mit den Gründern, Reference Calls. Wer im Prozess sitzt, sagen wir dir vorher. Entscheidung in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Wochen. Deine Bewerbung Schick uns zwei bis drei Projekte, auf die du stolz bist, und in zwei Sätzen, warum.   • Produktion briefen. Für Film, Design und größere Produktionen arbeitest du mit Freelancern und Spezialisten. Du briefst sie, beurteilst, was zurückkommt, und hältst die Marke über alle Kanäle konsistent.
  • Social Media, UGC und Community. Hinter marta steht eine große Community aus Betreuungskräften. Daraus machst du Formate, Geschichten und nutzergenerierte Inhalte. Unser Ziel: der größte Pflegekanal Deutschlands. 
  • PR und Presse. Du arbeitest mit einer PR-Agentur, schreibst Pressemitteilungen und baust Regionalpresse als Kanal auf.
  • CRM und Lifecycle. Die Entscheidung für eine 24-Stunden-Betreuung zieht sich über Wochen. Willkommensstrecken, Reaktivierung, WhatsApp: die richtige Botschaft zum richtigen Zeitpunkt statt nur Bottom of Funnel. Die Strecken füllst du mit dem richtigen Content und hast ein Auge dafür was funktioniert und was nicht.
  • Botschaft und Tonalität. Du übersetzt unsere fünf Personas in konkrete Botschaften und Touchpoints. Familien entscheiden emotional und nach Qualität, nicht nach Preis. Dein Text muss das treffen.

Dazu kommen die Themen, die du als Erstes in die Hand nimmst: Bewertungen und Google Business Profile, eine Mechanik für Empfehlungen, Regionalpresse und die Sichtbarkeit von marta in der KI-Suche.


So sieht Erfolg aus
Nach 90 Tagen: die erste CRM-Strecke ist live, zwei Kanäle sind erfolgreich angetestet, die ersten Ergebnisse sind vielversprechend, und wir gehen in die Skalierung.

Das bringst du zu uns mit

Auf diese fünf Punkte schauen wir. Alles danach ist ein Plus und kein Filter.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre in Marke, Kampagnen oder Content. Agentur oder inhouse, beides passt. Die Jahre sind nicht das Kriterium, die Arbeiten sind es.

Das hilft zusätzlich
  • Du hast selbst einmal einen Social-Media-Account aufgebaut und zum Laufen gebracht, beruflich oder privat.

  • du konzipieren, aber nicht schreiben willst. Am Anfang entstehen die Texte an deinem Schreibtisch.

  • du Kreation nach Geschmack beurteilst statt nach Wirkung.

About Us

Nopan is a payment performance platform built by former merchants, focused exclusively on account and wallet payment methods. We help large merchants, fintechs, and PSPs turn payments into measurable revenue drivers. We are payments nerds who are excited about global changes happening in the industry and we want and know how to make it better. In just 18 months, we secured our license from the Dutch Central Bank, formed partnerships with Europe's major payment schemes, including becoming a Principal Member of EPI/Wero, and went live with initial customers. Backed by leading investors, we are now scaling to become the default performance layer for account and wallet payments in Europe. If you're excited about solving big problems and creating something from the ground up, this is the place for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with the founding team to define, design, and implement the core product.

  • Contribute to product strategy and roadmap discussions, bringing your technical expertise to the table.

  • Take ownership of entire features from conception to deployment, and iterate based on user feedback.

  • Set up and maintain the tech infrastructure, including cloud services, databases, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Set up data storage solutions and ensure data integrity and security.

  • Optimize system performance and scalability to support a growing user base.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in backend development with a strong command of Java and related frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot).

  • Proven experience deploying and managing applications on AWS, utilizing services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others.

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for orchestrating containerized applications in production environments.

  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and database management (SQL/NoSQL).

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation, and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and handle ambiguity in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

  • Passion for building efficient and scalable systems from the ground up.

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Plus

  • Experience in payment processing or integrating with payment gateways, handling transactions, and ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations.

What’s in It for You

  • Join a passionate team of ex-Netflix, Visa, Microsoft veterans at the ground level and shape the company’s technology stack.

  • Be part of the founding team and have a significant impact on the direction of the company.

  • Equity in the company, allowing you to share in the success you help create.

  • Flexible work arrangements and a supportive work environment.

  • We support and invest in your growth, including covering the cost of relevant courses, certifications, and training programs.

  • Endless opportunities for professional growth as the company scales.

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Read this part first

Somewhere out there is a sourcer who is better than their job title says they are. They hit their numbers at a company that never let them talk to a hiring manager. They found the candidate nobody else found and watched a recruiter take the credit. They have been told to be patient, to wait for the next cycle, to earn it.

We are not going to make you wait.

What we do

We build autonomous aircraft and Legion, the software that flies hundreds of them as one coordinated swarm. Series A, backed by Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. We are hiring software engineers and aircraft engineers at the same time, which is hard, and how fast we hire is one of the few things standing between the current aircraft and the next one.

That is not a motivational line. It is the actual constraint. Recruiting is on the critical path here, and you will be able to see your work in the flight schedule.

The job

You own top of funnel for our software engineering roles: backend, frontend, autonomy, forward deployed. You will be reading GitHub profiles, writing outreach that engineers answer, and building searches that keep producing after the obvious names are gone.

Then the interesting part. Inside your first year you move onto the aircraft side: propulsion, structures, avionics, manufacturing, production. Almost nobody sources both. The people who can are rare enough that it changes what your career looks like from that point forward. We will teach you, and you will be bad at it for a while, and then you will not be.

What you get here that you did not get there

  • Your own reqs, early, with your name on the outcome

  • Hiring managers in the same building, not behind an intake form

  • The freedom to change the message when it is not working, without asking three people first

  • Someone who runs sourcing searches themselves every day and will look at your search strings with you

  • A skill set at the end of two years that maybe a few hundred people in the country have

What we need from you

  • 1+ years of sourcing or recruiting, most of it in software engineering

  • A hire you are proud of, one nobody else was going to find, and the ability to walk us through exactly how you found them

  • A high tolerance for silence, because most of your outreach will go unanswered and the job is making the next message better anyway

  • Real curiosity about how aircraft get built, or at least the honesty to say you find it interesting and want in

  • Writing that sounds like a person, since your entire work product is text a stranger decides to open or delete

  • Clean data habits, because our reporting goes to the CEO and it needs to be right

What we do not need

Ten years of experience. A recruiting pedigree. A degree in anything specific. Permission from your current manager to be good at this.

The honest version

The pace is uncomfortable. You will be asked to fill roles you do not understand yet, and the answer will usually be to go learn them rather than to wait for a briefing.

If you want a clear ladder and a quiet quarter, this is the wrong job. If you have been waiting for someone to hand you something real, this is the shot.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.


Tech Profile

  • Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

  • Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
    experiment and iterate.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
    cause of issues.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
    technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
    tight deadlines.

  • Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
    propose solutions.

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
    action.

  • Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”

We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy

We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions.
